decisions.reason: As a decorative devoré variant close to existing lines, its market test should largely be resolved by 2022 and, absent clear evidence of standout demand, the firm is likely to free warehouse and sampling capacity for stronger items.

A transparent burnout decorative fabric is a relatively fashion-sensitive niche option, so once uncertainty has had time to resolve the firm is more likely to discontinue it if it has not become a dependable reorder product.
This burnout decorative fabric fits the existing assortment but overlaps with other decorative launches, making it a plausible candidate for pruning after several seasons if sales are only average.

A velour-like upholstery fabric sits closer to the firm’s core upholstery offer and can benefit from reorder continuity, so the option value of keeping it remains reasonable unless sales have clearly disappointed.
The flame-retardant plain inbetween fabric serves a functional and potentially regulation-driven need, which makes demand less fashion-dependent and supports keeping it in the range.

A polyester lining fabric with satin sheen is a practical complement to the firm’s service-oriented textile offering, so despite some overlap risk its carrying cost is likely low enough to justify retention for now.
